description_en: Queries the execution logs of a lifecycle management policy. You can query logs from the last 90 days, with a maximum of 1000 log entries. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported
description_zh:
查询生命周期策略的运行日志。
可查询最近 90 天或最多 1000 条日志。
仅 CPFS 智算版支持
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-lifecycle-policy-logs --file-system-id bmcpfs-030wldnqm8evtpy0000 --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLifecyclePolicyLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lifecycle management policy
parameters.name: lifecycle_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of log entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每个分页包含的日志条数。

取值范围：1~100
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
列表的分页页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

LifecyclePolicyLogs.description_en: The execution logs of the lifecycle management policy
LifecyclePolicyLogs.description_zh: 生命周期策略的运行日志

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh:
任务创建时间。
以 ISO 8601 为标准，并使用 UTC+0 时间，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DeleteRules.description_en: The file data expiration and deletion rules. A maximum of one rule can be configured
DeleteRules.description_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则，最多配置 1 个

items.description_en: The file data expiration and deletion rules. A maximum of one rule can be configured
items.description_zh: 文件数据过期删除规则，最多配置 1 个

Attribute.description_en:
The attribute of the rule.

Valid values:
Atime: the last access time of the file
Attribute.description_zh:
规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间

Threshold.description_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, this parameter specifies the number of days since the file was last accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
Threshold.description_zh:
规则的阈值。

取值：
当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]

Paths.description_en: The execution paths of the specified retrieval task
Paths.description_zh: 指定取回任务的执行路径

items.description_en: The execution paths of the specified retrieval task
items.description_zh: 指定取回任务的执行路径

Attribute.description_en:
The attribute of the rule. Valid values:
RetrieveType: the retrieval method
Attribute.description_zh:
规则的属性，取值：
RetrieveType: 取回方式

Threshold.description_en:
The threshold of the rule. Valid values:
RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit: Supported when LifecyclePolicyType=Auto. Indicates best-effort recall on visit.
    - All: Supported when LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand. Indicates retrieving all data
Threshold.description_zh:
规则的阈值，取值：
RetrieveType
    - AfterVisit：LifecyclePolicyType=Auto 支持，代表尽力 recall on visit
    - All: LifecyclePolicyType=OnDemand 支持，代表取回所有

Status.description_en:
The status of the data retrieval task. Valid values:
PENDING: Being created.
RUNNING: Running.
STOPPED: Stopped.
FINISHED: Finished.
FAILED: Failed
Status.description_zh:
数据取回任务的状态。包括：
PENDING：创建中
RUNNING：执行中
STOPPED：已停止
FINISHED：已结束
FAILED：失败

StorageType.description_en:
The tiered storage type. Valid values:
InfrequentAccess: IA storage class (default).
Archive: Archive storage
StorageType.description_zh:
分级存储类型。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储（默认值）。
Archive：归档存储

The attribute of the rule.

规则的属性。

取值：
Atime: 文件的访问时间

Threshold.description_en:
The threshold of the rule.

Valid values:
If Attribute is set to Atime, this parameter specifies the number of days since the file was last accessed. Valid values: 1 to 365
Threshold.description_zh:

当 Attribute 为 Atime 时，表示多少天未访问的文件，取值范围[1,365]

PageSize.description_en: The number of log entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的日志条数

Success.description_en:
The request status. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed

请求状态。

包括：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
